name: Maddur Vada
steps: Mix semolina, rice flour, all-purpose flour, onion, minced chilli, curry leaves, cumin and salt. Rub together to draw moisture from onion.
Add water gradually and bring together into a stiff, rough dough; do not knead it smooth like roti dough.
Divide into small balls and flatten thinly between oiled sheets, leaving ragged onion-studded edges.
Fry in moderately hot oil, turning until both sides are richly golden and the centre has no raw flour taste.
Drain on a rack and serve warm with coconut chutney or tea.
tips: Flatten the discs thinly; thick patties remain soft rather than developing Maddur vada’s signature snap.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
